body:
Addressed:

- Added before and after screenshots for the Properties tool page and Tool shape window to the PR body. All four images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch at `9e0e6ec5f9b1561c4ed14313c72cf18cf11c6911`. No images are on the PR branch.
- Guarded the existing-tool heading and actions against an empty Properties target. `new_tool_matching_saved_name_has_no_empty_target_actions` pins the matching-name path, Apply, and Close. Reverting only the guard made the test fail. Restoring the guard made it pass. The final test also passed.

New head: `4f75a6692f7bf7d7fb17bcf73b8c672bad206a83`.

The quick gate passed all 9 selected steps after one failed-step rerun. The first UI library run exited with SIGSEGV. The rerun passed 1284 tests, with 0 failures and 7 ignored. Clippy passed for `camcraft-ui`, with 0 warnings.

Please re-review this head.
